title: p2025 organisation
description: An organisation the volume names: a civil-society body that contributed to it or sat on its advisory board, or a government agency that employs one of its people.

kind.description: civil_society = a non-governmental body; government = an agency or department. Empty when the volume does not say.

project_2025_advisory_board.description: True only where the organisation is printed on the volume's advisory board list (p. 11).

source_ids.description: Documents that substantiate the organisation's own claims, chiefly its advisory-board seat.

url.description: The organisation's public site, where one was recorded. Empty otherwise.
